# TryFundable

TryFundable provides private-market company, investor, person, funding-deal, location, and industry data for fundraising research and prospecting.

Category: Finance. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tryfundable/.

## Actions

- **Get Deal** (read-only): Return one funding deal by its Fundable UUID, including company and investor IDs, financing, valuation, and source details.
- **Get Entity** (read-only): Return the full profile for one company, investor firm, or person.
- **List Deal Investors** (read-only): Return the firm investors, involved personnel, and angel investors associated with one funding deal.
- **List Entity Deals** (read-only): Return one page of funding deals associated with a company, investor firm, or person.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Discover companies using company attributes, latest funding round, and investor filters.
- **Search Deals** (read-only): Find funding rounds across company histories using deal, company, or investor filters.
- **Search Entities** (read-only): Resolve a company, investor firm, or person by providing exactly one supported search field.
- **Search Investors** (read-only): Discover investor firms using firm attributes and portfolio-company investment filters.
- **Search People** (read-only): Discover founders, employees, angels, and lead investors using person, employer, and investment-activity filters.
- **Search Taxonomy** (read-only): Find canonical location, industry, or super-category permalinks for use in discovery filters.
